newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle sales brisk-$118/dressed-trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle sales brisk-$118/dressed-trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle near midday Wednesday were actively selling at $117.00 to $118.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, steady to up $1 from Tuesday, according to market sources.
About 25,000 head were reported sold, with trading expected to continue through the day, they said.
"I think we'll trade most of our showlist today," one market source said.
This week's showlist was pegged at 65,000 head.
Sales on a live basis in Nebraska were reported at $73.00, mostly steady with Tuesday, with a few above that level on a delivered basis, sources there said.
